purpose: Audit/specification evidence; not a production coverage or dataset admission claim
source_inspection_method: Read adapter specifications, factories, instruments, decoders and sessions; official documentation fetched through web tool. No live run or tests by source reviewer.

pilot_evidence.rule: Do not assign observed/reconciled/qualified statuses until scope-specific analyzer output exists.

evidence_vocabulary.specified: reference reviewed, subject to explicit failures and contradictions
evidence_vocabulary.implemented: source exists and inspected; never equivalent to live evidence
evidence_vocabulary.fixture: test source paths present, execution separate
evidence_vocabulary.independently_reconciled: independent source key/count/value comparison within exact bounds
evidence_vocabulary.storage_dataset_qualified: immutable manifest and use-specific quality contract passed
evidence_vocabulary.consumer_compatible: actual target reader and representative data verified
evidence_vocabulary.operational_promotion: calendar canaries and multi-day requirements unchanged

okx.reviewed_claims: V5 trades aggregates per taker/price/source; count and last constituent tradeId; repeated seqId allowed; trades-all on business emits individual trades; spot size base, derivatives contracts; public history three months, max100 rows, 20req/2s. Regional eligibility/access not tested.

binance_spot.reviewed_claims: Spot raw trade differs from taker-aggregated aggTrade; IDs and first/last constituent IDs differ; m is buyer-maker.

binance_routes.reviewed_claims: Current USD-M public/market/private routing; aggregate trades use market; unrouted connections only receive public-class streams; 24-hour connection lifetime; no live route inference.

binance_notice.reviewed_claims: Maps bookTicker/depth to public and aggTrade/mark/kline/ticker/liquidations to market. Legacy migration deadline stated 2026-04-23. Verify actual runtime instead of assuming legacy comments remain true.

binance_archive.reviewed_claims: Official spot/USD-M/Coin-M daily/monthly archive schemas, per-file checksums and possible later replacements. Spot archive times since 2025-01-01 are microseconds; futures schemas distinguish quoteQty and baseQty.

binance_coinm.reviewed_claims: Coin-M dstream connection reference; shared-looking protocol is not evidence of USD-M routing parity or current contract migration completion.

kraken_spot.reviewed_claims: v2 trade rows may batch unrelated takers; taker side; trade_id unique sequence per book; RFC3339 time; snapshot latest50.

kraken_history.reviewed_claims: Public Trades since/count<=1000; example cursor last; no universal retention established. Current API includes tokenized_asset parameter outside reviewed crypto catalog.

kraken_futures.reviewed_claims: Futures WS uid, taker side, subscription seq, millisecond trade time, fill/liquidation/termination/block classification.

bybit.reviewed_claims: V5 publicTrade taker side, fill milliseconds, opaque ID, block/RPI flags; up to1024 rows, multiple messages can share seq; option subscription differs.

bybit_history.reviewed_claims: Recent REST spot max60, other categories1000, links official archive website; not proof arbitrary missing intervals are recoverable.

deribit.reviewed_claims: Instrument trade channel has interval raw/100ms/agg2 and arrays of trades; raw access requires authorization; notification batching does not justify inventing constituent executions.

deribit_history.reviewed_claims: REST per-currency trade_id, per-instrument trade_seq, taker direction, ms timestamp, amount and optional contracts; seq/time filters, explicit sorting, count max1000. Optional Starbase causal ns, liquidation/block/combo fields; no public universal retention proven.

deribit_collection.reviewed_claims: Raw auth, batching, per-instrument ordering, instrument lifecycle feed and public trade backfill methods. Private historical-retention statements must not be applied to public data.

intx_migration.reviewed_claims: States INTX consolidated into Deribit 2026-10-01, new endpoints/keys/runtime USDC discovery, linear amount base versus inverse USD; legacy historical APIs about12 months. No account, strategy or state migration authorized here.

gemini.reviewed_claims: Current multiplexed @trade: E ns, t numeric ID, p/q decimal strings, m buyer-maker; @bookTicker and depth snapshot parameter.

gemini_history.reviewed_claims: Max500; since_tid; newest-first; taker side; broken-trade option. Contradiction: headline seven calendar days versus timestamp description90-day hard limit; effective retention unresolved.

bitstamp.reviewed_claims: Transactions time=minute/hour/day. Current page includes derivatives surfaces beyond implemented spot. Commercial usage terms and endpoint limits require acquisition-specific review; no universal history established.

bitstamp_ws.reviewed_claims: Accessible response but parsed content empty; cannot independently confirm current WS field/side claims from this fetch.

bitfinex.reviewed_claims: WSv2 signed AMOUNT is taker buy/sell, MTS ms, ID; snapshot plus te/tu updates. Funding trades are a different tuple/schema.

bitfinex_history.reviewed_claims: Public hist: max10000, inclusive ms start/end, MTS sort, 15req/min; retention not guaranteed by reviewed page.

coinbase_classic.reviewed_claims: Exchange matches may drop; heartbeat last trade ID plus REST recovery documented; initial last_match is historical context. Ticker batching not a full tape.

coinbase_adv.reviewed_claims: Advanced market_trades batches250ms; batch is transport delivery, preserve rows.

coinbase_endpoints.reviewed_claims: Current spot/US derivatives and separate global derivatives endpoints; heartbeats needed for idle subscriptions; documented USD/USDC aliases. Catalog implementation remains spot only.

coinbase_intl.reviewed_claims: Legacy INTX MATCH no snapshot, aggressor_side includes OPENING_FILL; additional FUNDING/RISK/CANDLES exist in docs. Published legacy docs do not prove post-migration service viability.
